title: Overnight Steel-Cut Oats
summary: Ten minutes the night before, a hot breakfast in the morning. No packet required.
photoNote: Photo: bowl of oats with berries
why: Steel-cut oats are whole oat kernels, chopped — nothing added. Starting them the night before takes the half-hour wait out of the morning.

ingredients.item: Berries or chopped fruit, to serve

substitutions: Whole milk for half the water, for creamier oats.
Top with nuts or a spoon of plain yogurt instead of fruit.
method: In the evening, bring the water and salt to a boil in a saucepan.
Stir in the oats and let them boil for 1 minute.
Turn off the heat, put the lid on and leave the pan on the stove overnight.
In the morning, warm the oats over medium-low heat for 5–10 minutes, stirring. Add a splash of water or milk if they’re too thick.
Serve topped with the fruit. Leftovers keep in the fridge for up to 5 days.

tip.label: At the Grocer’s
tip.text: The ingredient list should say one thing: oats. Skip the flavoured instant packets.
